title: MyRecon vs Intelligence X: OSINT Workflows Compared
description: Compare MyRecon and Intelligence X: search inputs, search archives and verification limits. Choose an OSINT tool for authorized research.
h1: MyRecon vs Intelligence X: compare OSINT search workflows
intro: Compare Intelligence X and MyRecon by the question you need to answer. Intelligence X describes selector-based document research; MyRecon helps review public username candidates and supported exposure checks. This comparison does not establish superior accuracy or complete coverage.

sections.heading: What Intelligence X documents
sections.body: Intelligence X accepts selectors such as domains, URLs, email addresses and IP addresses. Its interface offers source and date filters and marks several collections as PRO. Review the collection date before treating a cached document as evidence of the present.

sections.heading: What MyRecon checks and what a result means
sections.body: MyRecon checks public usernames across a supported catalogue of 500+ platforms. The chosen scan scope determines which checks run. Found means a lead for source review. Not found does not guarantee registration availability. Unknown means the check could not reach a reliable conclusion. Email and password-exposure tools are separate checks, not a complete inventory of every account.

sections.heading: Illustrative decision: A domain mention and a public profile
sections.body: For an authorized domain review, record the selector, source bucket, document date and relevant excerpt. Recheck any current claim against the original service. A domain mention in an archived document does not establish who controls a public profile.

sections.heading: Access and costs before you choose
sections.body: MyRecon guest Quick scans show a limited preview. Standard scans require sign-in; account and plan limits apply. Paid features are described on the current pricing page. Check Intelligence X provider terms and available fields separately. This page does not claim either service is unlimited, always free or anonymous, and includes no paid-account or same-scope benchmark.

sections.heading: Record evidence and verify your next action
sections.body: For each authorized check, record the exact input, date, scope, result status and source URL. Keep unknown outcomes separate from negative results. Confirm accounts you own through an existing login or official recovery process, apply the privacy or security change, and recheck the specific exposure. A shared username alone does not identify a person.

faq.question: Is MyRecon a direct replacement for Intelligence X?
faq.answer: It depends on the task. Public profile discovery and selector-based document research have different inputs and evidence limits. Compare the required workflow before switching.

faq.question: Can I try MyRecon for free?
faq.answer: Guest Quick scans offer a limited preview. Standard scans require sign-in, and account and plan limits apply. See the current pricing page.

faq.question: Does a match prove ownership?
faq.answer: No. A shared username, similar name or historical record is not ownership proof. Keep uncertain matches unconfirmed and review independent evidence.
